evidence.supports: Mem's native API uses customer-created Bearer API keys that must be kept out of browsers and securely loaded by a server.
The v2 API supports cursor-bounded note listing with content disabled by default and collection or content-type filters.
The v2 API creates notes with full Markdown bodies up to 200000 characters and optional IDs collections and timestamps.
Current v2 writes use create-only caller IDs and exact current versions for conflict-safe note updates; rate and complexity headers are available.
Mem documents the product surface across notes collections attachments and audio recordings; Relay exposes it through fixed-origin REST wrappers rather than requiring provider-hosted MCP OAuth.
